name: Dumbbell Reverse-Grip Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on a bench with feet wide and hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing back.
Lean forward slightly and brace the back of your working upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder with knuckles on top, then lower slowly under control.
Complete the working arm, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Avoid rolling your wrist palm up during the lift.
Keep your upper arm planted on your thigh and your wrist aligned with your forearm.
